title: borg_update_light() takes BI_LIGHT (the engine's cur_light) as the light radius, but the game lights ABS(cur_light) - 1, so the Borg marks one ring of dark grids as lit

impact.description: In borg-reborn-rs's Rust port (borg-core, the same code) a monster two grids away in the dark with a torch is 'expected visible' (borg_follow_kill_aux), not seen, and deleted: borg_follow_kill deletes on every path that passes its checks (borg-rs's C bug 24, docs/c-borg/borg-rs-c-bugs.md group 24). Human Mage 461220874, borg-zoo run 44936494812: 44 of 50 worm forgets (borg-reborn-rs#877). Not reproduced on a native C game.

notes: Found by borg-reborn-rs (#877, #884; this record #886), not by borg-rs's discovery list (docs/c-borg/borg-rs-c-bugs.md, group 4 keeps the radius-2 shape 'as is') nor among better-borg-c's verified fixes (docs/c-borg/fixes/). Related, distinct defects in the same function: CBUG-0003 (west radius-2 shoulders omitted) and CBUG-0024 (duplicate light-list entries). Also: borg_check_light_only (src/borg/borg-light.c:109-237) tests BI_LIGHT == 1 / > 1 (:140, :181) as if they were radius 1 and 2, and borg_light_beam (:706-739) steps BI_LIGHT + 1 grids. The canonical tracker issue (diegoami/neo-angband-tracker, as every other finding) is not yet opened: this session cannot write there. Fixed in borg-reborn-rs behind cave_light_engine_radius (PRs #888, #894; shipped 1 on track-p, #1078/#1079).

references.description: radius 1 when BI_LIGHT >= 1, radius 2 when BI_LIGHT >= 2: BI_LIGHT taken as the radius
borg_update_light: radius-2 shape lights (2,2) north and south (distance 3) and misses (2,1); radius-3 corners (3,3) are at distance 4
calc_lighting: radius = ABS(cur_light) - 1 (add_light :616-646 lights distance() <= radius)
Wooden Torch: LIGHT_2, so cur_light 2 lights distance 1
the light radius is one too large: unseen monsters two grids away deleted
the dark flow, dark frontier, Light Beam and Call Light read the same radius

next_at_import: Open the canonical neo-angband-tracker issue, then a native C reproduction (a torch, a monster two grids away in the dark, borg_follow_kill deletes it) and a local proposal: radius = BI_LIGHT - 1 (necromancer unlight keeps C's radius), the engine's shape (distance() <= radius), and the same radius in borg_check_light_only and borg_light_beam.
